descriptionByLocale.en:
Your environment: You work in a small team at the Waldhaus Clinic site in Chur. Cooperative structures, motivated colleagues, and a professional exchange at eye level characterize our collaboration.

You think analytically and have a structured and solution-oriented way of working. You possess very good application knowledge in SAP in the modules FI/CO. You benefit from advanced working conditions.
